selection: first 64 dev rows in existing order, no label or outcome selection
ensemble: three GPU-resident models, sequential inference, exact-string vote2 and VA mean
timing: synchronized wall time; pretokenized CPU batches; includes H2D, model.predict and decoding, excludes tokenization, loading, scoring; ensemble includes CPU voting
memory: torch peak allocated/reserved; single model on GPU alone; ensemble all three resident; allocator cleared before warmup
caveat: One fixed English dev workload, no training or test scoring; does not establish all-language or production latency.
